verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows run unattended in the background. They fire from Schedule, HTTP/Webhook, Email, RSS and app-event triggers, retry errored events automatically, and email the owner on unhandled errors. A community user confirms a production setup that 'auto-feeds into an Algolia index'. missing for 10: detailed docs on AI agents running autonomously in the background (only a one-line marketing claim), and documented current execution-time limits for long-running background jobs (the only figures are older community-reported caps like 30s for cron).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: ... HTTP / Webhook ... Schedule ... Email ... RSS
